svg.text: the 14 samples (block -37..-35, 11..15) stand on the carriageway
Block frame, m (Splice's nw-corner view). Orange: carriageways. Dark: the world's buildings. Grey: built for the walk grid.
Green: the access pavements, kerb 1.5 + walk 2 + frontage 3 = 6.5 m, kerb to building line, with trees, lamps, bins.
The plan and the world have the footway; the walk grid blocks a built plot to its edge, pavement and all.
